> **Platform**: Android

# ZodiakBody ✅ Ported

```kotlin
@Composable
fun ZodiakBody(
    text: String,
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
    color: Color = Color.Unspecified,
    textAlign: TextAlign? = null,
    maxLines: Int = Int.MAX_VALUE,
)
```

Style: `MaterialTheme.typography.bodyMedium` (14sp Normal)
iOS equivalent: `ZodiakText(style: .body())`

**When to use:** Standard body text, descriptions, intro text.
